Game Overview

Paulie the Pizza is a arcade game built around guide Paulie, the feisty pizza slice, through a deliciously perilous world in this dynamic arcade adventure. Master fast-paced platforming and navigate tricky puzzles to outsmart culinary adversaries. With quirky charm and a vibrant pixelated aesthetic, stay quick and clever to avoid becoming the ultimate snack!
